issues.summary: The embedded-macro producer only consumed control-level EventMacros, so form/report-owned OnOpenEmMacro edges were not representable and any raw *EmMacro missed by the enricher was silently dropped.
issues.fix: Surface object-level EventMacros on IrFormOrReport, scan both object and control level, and emit an explicit embedded-macro-unparsed UnresolvedChainTarget when a *EmMacro property has no structured EventMacros.

issues.summary: TempVars recovery used a non-token-aware regex that could fabricate SuppliesParameter edges from string literals or substring matches.
issues.fix: Add a left identifier boundary and blank string literals before scanning (R1 fix); ultimately replaced with a token-aware scanner (R3) that skips string-literal and bracketed spans wholesale.

issues.summary: Inline SQL was marked parsed on any exception-free recovered AST, so a recovered-but-empty parse silently lost FeedsRecordSource edges with no record-source-unparsed entry.
issues.fix: Emit record-source-unparsed whenever an inline record source yields zero FROM/JOIN table sources, a stronger criterion than 'no exception'.

issues.summary: SortEdges/SortUnresolved comparators were not total (case-insensitive Name/Member with no ordinal tie-breaker; List.Sort is unstable).
issues.fix: Add Ordinal tie-breakers after the OrdinalIgnoreCase compares in CompareEndpoint.

issues.summary: ParseFormRefPath fabricated '?' Form/Report endpoints for blank or malformed reference paths (default-injection).
issues.fix: Return (null, null) for blank/malformed paths and emit an explicit unresolvable-reference UnresolvedChainTarget instead of a synthetic endpoint.
